title: Compiler Module — Math Notation Syntax Kernel
description:
Replace the Typst dependency (typst/typst-svg/typst-assets) used for math/emoji/text icon rendering (infinite-canvas icon_codec) and animate MathText/Text labels with a home-grown semio-native incremental document compiler module (`compiler`), built following the approved plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/we-want-to-replace-serialized-pinwheel.md.

This ticket covers Wave 0 (module scaffolding: 🧰️framework/🔨️modules/📚️compiler/ facade + sub-slots, workspace/nx registration) and Wave 1 (syntax kernel: a NEW semio math notation — function-call syntax like frac(a,b), mat(1,2;3,4), x^2, x_1 — built on top of the existing dsl_core token alphabet + dsl_grammar `.grammar` normative-spec infrastructure, following the established "own pre-scan lexer for extras not in the shared alphabet, delegate the rest to dsl_core::lex" pattern that dsl_grammar itself and mathematical_graph_dsl already use). Deliverable: a `math_notation` crate with lexer, AST, recursive-descent parser with error recovery, canonical printer (round-trip law), a normative `math.grammar` file, and tests — parsing the math snippets currently expressed as Typst markup (e.g. "x^2"), but NOT yet rendering them (layout/fonts/SVG emission is Wave 2+, tracked separately). Typst itself stays in place and functional until the full snippet pipeline (Wave 2) and call-site swap (Wave 3) land in later tickets — this ticket does not remove any typst dependency yet.

Repo-fact context already gathered: typst call sites are 🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/♾️infinite/🖼️canvas/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs (icon_codec) and ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🎞️animate/🔨️modules/🫀️core/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs (mod text). dsl_core lex() and dsl_grammar Recognizer/parse_grammar/print_grammar are at 🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🗣️dsl/{🫀️core,📖️grammar}/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs — already read in full.
summary:
Delivered Wave 0 (module scaffolding) and Wave 1 (math-notation syntax kernel) of the compiler-replaces-Typst plan (/Users/ueli/.claude/plans/we-want-to-replace-serialized-pinwheel.md).

New module 🧰️framework/🔨️modules/📚️compiler/ with two crates, both registered as explicit root Cargo.toml workspace members and cargo check/test/clippy clean:
- semio-framework-compiler (facade, lib `compiler`) — currently re-exports compiler_syntax as `compiler::syntax`; more sub-slots (🌍️world, ⚙️eval, 📐️layout, targets, …) land in later waves/tickets.
- semio-framework-compiler-syntax (slot 📖️syntax, lib `compiler_syntax`) — the semio math notation: a pre-scan lexer (extends dsl_core's shared token alphabet with `_ ; < > !`, delegating everything else to dsl_core::lex, following the exact pattern dsl_grammar/mathematical_graph_dsl already established), a MathNode AST, a recursive-descent parser (parse_formula), and a canonical printer (print/canonicalize) satisfying the round-trip law. Covers scripts (x^2, x_1), fractions/roots/matrices/cases/accents as generic function calls (frac(a,b), mat(1,2;3,4), sqrt(x), hat(x), …), emoji shortcodes (:rocket:), text-in-math, relations/arrows (=, !=, <=, >=, <, >, ->), and explicit-vs-implicit multiplication (2*x renders a dot, 2x doesn't). Ships a normative 📖️math.grammar (dsl_grammar format) with a self-conformance test proving it parses/round-trips under dsl_grammar's own parser. 17 unit tests, all passing; clippy clean (workspace lints).

Scope note: this ticket covers ONLY the math-notation syntax kernel, not the broader document markup mode (headings/emph/raw prose) — that's deferred to whichever later ticket needs it, since it has no bearing on replacing Typst's math/icon usage. No layout, fonts, or SVG emission yet (Wave 2), and Typst itself is untouched — both existing call sites (infinite-canvas icon_codec, animate mod text) still use typst and remain fully functional. The call-site swap and typst dependency removal are separate, later tickets (Wave 2 snippet pipeline, then Wave 3 atomic migration) per the plan.

Environment note: `bunx nx show projects` in this sandboxed session intermittently mangles emoji path segments (reproduced on a pre-existing, unrelated crate too — 🖱️ui/🧊️wgpu — so it's a subprocess/locale artifact of this tool environment, not caused by these new files); nx auto-discovery of the new 📋️project.json (name @semio-tech/compiler-syntax-rs) should be spot-checked in a normal dev terminal.
